tools.name: search_use_cases
tools.description: Search 1,000+ vetted AI use cases by keyword, industry, or business workflow (e.g. 'invoice', 'dental', 'customer support'). Use when someone asks how AI can help their business, wants AI ideas for an industry, or looks for automation opportunities. Also use it to find the slug before get_agent_play

tools.name: get_use_case
tools.description: Full detail for one use case by slug: the problem, how the AI workflow works, tools, implementation notes, and source link.

tools.name: list_industries
tools.description: All industries and sub-industries covered, with use-case counts. Use to browse or when the user's industry is unclear.

tools.name: get_industry
tools.description: Top AI use cases for one industry or sub-industry, with links.

tools.name: get_agent_playbook
tools.description: Agent playbook for one published use case, by slug. Signed-out calls are an HTTP 401 so the client can open Sign in to The AI Integration Hub; the library tools stay public. After sign-in the JSON access field is full (follow the playbook, then offer its schedule only if the user confirms), free_cla

tools.name: run_agent
tools.description: Launch a published Hub agent by name or slug. Use when the user asks in plain language or opens an agent prompt. Pass slug when you know it, or name for their words. Same access states as get_agent_playbook: full, free_claim_available (claim true only after they say yes), preview upgrade, and a sign

tools.name: get_ai_services
tools.description: The AI Integration Hub's implementation services (AI enablement, process reengineering, custom AI builds, AI strategy consulting) with starting prices and a contact link. Use when the user wants an AI consultant or help implementing.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_agent_playbook · Private data: get_ai_services · Public sink: run_agent · Destructive: run_agent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_agent_playbook · Private data: get_ai_services · Public sink: run_agent · Destructive: run_agent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_use_cases" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
